verdict.rationale: Runway publishes llms.txt files at both docs.dev.runwayml.com and runway.com, and a probe confirmed the dev docs file returns HTTP 200. The llms.txt points agents to raw Markdown versions of every page (append .md) and to a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, which a probe also confirmed. Agent plugins for Codex, Cursor and Claude Code add further agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of an agent successfully consuming these docs end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/llms.txt # Runway Dev
Every documentation page is also available as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to its path
Set up Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Grok Bot to build with Runway Dev
